claims.location: source name, comment[label], factor value[disease] rows 1-4
claims.value: SILAC heavy = AG03258 (WT, normal); SILAC light = AG11498 (HGPS)
claims.evidence: Supplementary Data 2 description (covers cytosol): "WT cells (AG3258) were completely labeled with heavy isotope while HGPS cells (AG11498) were maintained in light isotope containing media"; PRIDE title "...cytosol - AG3258 and AG11498"; paper Fig. 4d,e: cytosol from SILAC-labeled WT (AG3258) and HGPS (AG11498), Orbitrap Fusion. Data check: Supp Data 2 cytosol median %HEAVY 54.1 overall (n=989) but 39.3 for the 17 ribosomal proteins -> RPs enriched in light = HGPS, matching "we detected 17 RPs that were significantly upregulated in the cytosol of HGPS cells". The deposited file stem MCBLZ-1 does not name the sample; the mzid title / mzTab title (MHAB-AG11498-AG3258-cyto) and the PRIDE title tie it to this experiment. Technical replicates: _1 and _2 share 85% of the smaller run's peptides (Jaccard 0.65).

One heavy-labelled WT culture and one parallel light HGPS culture per mixture (paper Methods "For protein abundance analyses ... A parallel population of HGPS fibroblasts"); biological replicate restarts per factor group (rule 3), each group has one culture.

Cytosolic fraction = supernatant retained after pelleting nuclei ("The nuclei were pelleted and the supernatant retained for cytosolic fractions"); PRIDE title "...relative protein abundance in cytosol". GO:0005829 cytosol. Custom characteristics column (campaign rule 16: a compared subcellular fraction is a sample property; precedent column name characteristics[cellular component] in curated SDRFs).

mzXML msInstrument msModel "Orbitrap Fusion" (parentFile G:\Fusion_data\... or F:\MS-RAW\...); paper Methods: samples for Fig. 1, Fig. 4d,e and Supplementary Fig. 7 "were run on a Thermo Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid"; PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol also says Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid. PRIDE instruments field says "LTQ Orbitrap" (MS:1000449) - contradicted by raw metadata and protocol; raw wins.
ms2 header ActivationType CID; paper "CID fragmentation" / "CID MS/MS in the ion trap".
Every .ms2 filter line: "@cid35.00" (RawConverter header of each run).
Both .ms2 headers: InstrumentType ITMS, filter "ITMS + c NSI r d Full ms2 ...@cid35.00"; paper: "CID MS/MS in the ion trap". Orbitrap Fusion ion trap = linear ion trap.
Paper Methods: "operated in a data dependent mode" (Fusion) / "operated in data-dependent mode" (Q Exactive); ms2 headers "AcquisitionMethod Data-Dependent" and filter lines with " d Full ms2".

PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol and paper: "digested overnight with trypsin". mzIdentML Enzyme MS:1001251 Trypsin (search also allowed half-tryptic peptides per paper; recorded here as a note, the digestion enzyme is trypsin, rule 2).

claims.evidence: mzIdentML ParentTolerance 50.0 ppm and FragmentTolerance 600.0 ppm in every SpectrumIdentificationProtocol; paper/PRIDE: "searched with 50 ppm precursor ion tolerance and 600 ppm fragment ion tolerance" (post-search filter 10 ppm).
"reduced with TCEP; alkylated with chloroacetamide" (PRIDE protocol and paper Methods). PRIDE terms checked in OLS.

Each digest was injected directly (single-shot); no peptide fractionation described. SCX tips (pulse samples) were used for detergent removal, not fractionation. comment[fraction identifier] = 1 for every row.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Label:13C(6) K; Label:13C(6)15N(4) R
claims.evidence: Each mzIdentML holds two SpectrumIdentificationProtocols (IP2/ProLuCID): SIP_ for light spectra and SIP_H for the "H"-prefixed copy of the same mzXML. SIP_H adds fixed +6.0201 K (MOD:00544, 13C6 Lys = UNIMOD:188 Label:13C(6)) and +10.0083 R (MOD:00587, 13C6 15N4 Arg = UNIMOD:267 Label:13C(6)15N(4)); in the SDRF the label masses are written MT=Variable (campaign rule 11). Carbamidomethyl = 57.02146 C (MOD:00397), paper "Carbamidomethylation on cysteine was considered as a static modification". MHAB-AG11498-AG3258-cyto.mzid.gz: no variable modification; runs _1 and _2 searched together.

limitations: Runs _1 and _2 are treated as technical replicate injections of one mixture (suffix, joint search, 85% peptide overlap); the paper does not say.
File stem MCBLZ-1 is not a sample name; the cytosol identity rests on the PRIDE title and the search-result titles.

No vendor .raw files are deposited (none of PXD006012-PXD006016 has one); comment[data file] lists the RawConverter .ms2 files that PRIDE categorises as RAW. The .mzXML (PEAK) copies are not listed. Reprocessing from the SDRF will need .ms2/.mzXML-capable tools.

SILAC culture medium is not stated (paper: cells grown in MEM + 15% FBS for general culture; SILAC media base not named) -> characteristics[culture medium] not available. Passage stated only as "<20" -> not available. Storage temperature not stated.
Quiescence (1% serum for 3-5 days before harvest/labelling) applies to every sample and is encoded only in the source names, not as a treatment column.

characteristics[cell line] uses Cellosaurus IDs; validate-sdrf warns that AG03258 / HGFDFN168 are not in CLO/BTO/EFO under that spelling (CLO has "AG03258 cell"; AG11498 and HGADFN167 resolve). developmental stage "pediatric stage" (HsapDv:0000264) draws a validator warning (template lists EFO), used for the 14Y and 8Y5M donors per campaign rule 9.
characteristics[individual] = <line>_donor is a constructed label, not a published donor ID.
